title: Struggling with creating a decent looking game with Astra (currently trying to use Apple RealityKit + CoreMotion for a game) have spent days and a ridiculous amount of credits, any basic things I'm missing (first ever time making any type of game)
author: MysteriousHall7831
selftext: Really need some tips, If I'm trying to build something that looks kinda arcadey and silly with 3d motion what should my tech stack be?

comments.author: RUSuper
comments.body: Astra, Tripo AI, Claude for systems outside graphics, chatGPT image generation for mockups and asking Astra to replicate or ask astra in advance to make mockups and try to replicate them. Then tweak them afterwards more towards what you have in mind

replies.author: MysteriousHall7831
replies.body: lol wish I read this b4 burning like $500 bucks in credits yesterday, appreciate it. Do I need to use Unity as a game engine or can I avoid doing that and use Apple RealityKit as the engine

replies.author: RUSuper
replies.body: I use Godot, imo AI knows best to work in Godot still, but people use Unity and stuff. That being said all you see in Unity is prototypes I doubt anyone made full game in Unity with AI and released it. Godot works fine for me

replies.author: jl2l
replies.body: You're the kid that spends $500 to cheats on the test instead of just learning the material for free.

replies.author: HitMePat
replies.body: When you say "Tripo AI" is there some different platform than just using the tripo 3d site to generate models and export them?  Is there some way that Astra or Claude can interface with tripo directly?

replies.author: RUSuper
replies.body: Not sure, I use it over their website, I know they have Blender addon so Claude and Astra can probably use it via MCP for blender, you still need to pay though

comments.author: Bluetails_Buizel
comments.body: Depends on what project you are making and your current skill level. Yeah, tech stack is inportent as well,

comments.author: Majestic_Tip3261
comments.body: Genuinely wondering how somebody spends $500 on "credits." Do you not have a subscription of some type? You're just raw-dogging it with questions? I don't understand.

replies.author: MysteriousHall7831
replies.body: lol I ran thru my pro sub and they dont have the 20x sub available so I just kept adding credits

replies.author: Majestic_Tip3261
replies.body: Bro, just wait until you get the refresh.

replies.author: MysteriousHall7831
replies.body: my refresh is in like 4 days lol id rather spend the money than wait

replies.author: Majestic_Tip3261
replies.body: I mean, you can use that time to take a step back and plan out what you're doing, and then you can be more strategic about what you're asking Codex to do and maybe save some credits.

replies.author: MysteriousHall7831
replies.body: yea but like im reckless and impatient so I just spend the money. Honest to god it was pretty stupid but I always find that when I'm really aggressive and try to get things done as fast as possible I end up being resourceful enough to figure it out quick

comments.author: gamedevjp
comments.body: I’d watch some YouTube videos on how to make a game first or you’re never going to make anything of value even with AI.
